name: iform/web3-forms-mcp
description: Create, deploy, and manage decentralized Web3 forms and surveys on EVM chains via Model Context Protocol (MCP)

tools.name: generate_form_transaction
tools.description: Constructs a ready-to-sign on-chain EVM transaction for the FormFactory smart contract (createForm, closeForm, activateForm, archiveForm, updateSchemaHash) with exact 0.00005 ETH protocol fee.

tools.name: confirm_form
tools.description: Registers and indexes an on-chain created form in the IFORM registry with its questions schema, generating the 6-character short slug (e.g. /e3qa69) and live URL.

tools.name: query_forms
tools.description: Fetches indexed decentralized forms by chainId, creator/owner address, or status with real-time response counts and metadata.

tools.name: get_form_responses
tools.description: Retrieves public or wallet-authenticated submissions and responses recorded for a given form ID or slug.
